note: Lassen NF campground in mature pine and fir forest above the southwest shore of Eagle Lake, the quietest of the Eagle Lake Recreation Area campgrounds and about 5 miles from the marina and boat ramp. The loops are about 140 m through the forest from the lakeshore. The paved bike path to the other campgrounds starts here; a dump station is about 2 miles away. --Claude
summary: Christie (Lassen NF, Eagle Lake): rec.gov 232901 + FS page + Esri. Fees $28 -> $30 (rec.gov 2026/2027; FS still says $25); added weekend 2 / holiday 3 minimums, booking season, 69 sites to 65 ft with pull-throughs, vault toilets (flush cleared), no potable water, dump off-site; season mid-May to Sept. Not waterfront confirmed (loops ~140 m in forest from the shore). Phone flag.
flags: FEES: the Forest Service page posts $25 standard/RV and $40 group; recreation.gov charges $30 and $60 for 2026 and 2027. Wrote rec.gov.

FACILITIES: stored flush_toilets true came from note prose; the FS page lists 'Vault toilet(s)' only, so flush is cleared and vault written. The FS page also says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' (no water source named on rec.gov either).

SEASON: FS says 'May - September' and also 'Walk-In only season is from Labor Day to December 31st'; the page now shows 'Closed for 2026/2027 winter season'. Wrote mid-May to end of September with the walk-in season in the note.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' confirmed. Esri with all 66 rec.gov site points: every loop is in continuous forest; nearest site 39 (40.5687,-120.8358) is ~140 m through trees from the treeline/high-water edge and ~265 m from the current waterline. The FS 'on the southwestern shoreline' wording is marketing against that.

PHONE: empty -> (530) 825-3454 (rec.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (530) 825-3454'); rec.gov's facility_phone is 530-825-3212 and the Eagle Lake Ranger District is (530) 257-4188.
OHV: the operator notes 'almost direct access to the Forest Service riding trails' and bans off-road vehicles inside the campground: a general campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp.
ALERT: the FS page carries an active 'Harmful Algal Blooms' alert for Eagle Lake (not a closure).
